text.en:
The GMMG is hereby abolished. Its. properties, staff and
resources shall be transferred to the Office of the Press Secretary (OPS).

. The President of the Philippines shall appoint the Chairman,
President and General Manager of NBN-4. With respect to RPN-9 and IBC-13,
the President shall express her desire whom she wishes to be elected as Board
Members, Chairmen and Presidents thereof.
The Chairman of. NBN-4 shall. not hold any other government

The President and General Manager of NBN-4 shall be two
different persons. The same distinction shall apply to the Presidents and General
Managers of RPN-9 and IBC-13.

The National Printing Office and the APO Production Unit shall be
attached to the OPS.

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This. Executive Order shall take effect after its publication in
national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 7th day of November
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
in the year of
floris is. Aerogo
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PGA Hologram # 37438
